newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CA Hungary reports HUF2.35 bln 9-mo pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: CA Hungary reports HUF2.35 bln 9-mo pre-tax profit.

text.p: Creditanstalt Rt, the Hungarian unit of Austria's Creditanstalt Bankverein, almost reached last year's annual pre-tax profit in the first nine months of 1996, a company spokeswoman told Reuters.
Creditanstalt posted an IAS pre-tax profit of 2.35 billion forints in the January-September period while the bank's balance sheet total grew to 104 billion forints.

Comparative figures for the same nine months of 1995 were not immediately available but in the whole of 1995 the bank posted an IAS pre-tax profit of 2.429 billion forints on a balance sheet total of 76.975 billion forints, she said.
The bank also said in a statement that it was opening its eighth Hungarian branch on Friday in Szombathely, west Hungary.
